name: vouch
description: Vouch — spending guardrails for autonomous agents. Two things: (1) buy safely — an agent that completes purchases through PayPal while a Code-Level Guardrail Engine checks every order BEFORE it reaches PayPal, so no misread quantity and no prompt injection can overspend; (2) cancel before you're charged — scans your PayPal subscriptions and auto-cancels free trials that breach your spending policy before they auto-renew. Every action lands in a SHA-256 hash-chained audit dossier. Runs in demo mode without credentials; real PayPal sandbox with PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID/PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET.

skills.name: Buy Safely
skills.description: Complete a purchase through PayPal with spending guardrails enforced in code, not in a prompt. The buyer sets a plain-language policy (category, per-item cap, max quantity, per-order total, weekly budget, time window); the agent compiles it to structured rules and a deterministic check_order() validates the exact order facts BEFORE any PayPal call. If it fails, the order is rejected and zero calls go to PayPal. This is what blocks prompt injection: a seller note cannot override code-level limits. Returns orderId, approvalUrl, capture, and the dossier entry.
examples: Buy a $49.99 keyboard; my policy is electronics only, max $150 per item
Purchase 2 items under $300 total; nothing after 10pm

policy.description: Compiled spending policy (or plain-language policy object)

explicitOrder.description: Exact order facts so the LLM can't misparse quantities

skills.name: Cancel Before You're Charged
skills.description: The money-leak fix. Lists the buyer's PayPal billing agreements, checks each one against the active spending policy, and cancels the ones that would breach it BEFORE they auto-renew — so a forgotten free trial never charges you. Subscriptions that are within policy are kept with a reason. Each cancellation and review is appended to the hash-chained audit dossier. In demo mode three sample subscriptions are provided (Adobe, Spotify, Netflix).
examples: Review my subscriptions and cancel anything over $20
My free trials keep charging me — stop the ones I don't want

policy.description: Optional policy override; defaults to the active compiled policy

paypalClientCredentials.name: Authorization
paypalClientCredentials.description: Server uses PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID/PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET (env) for PayPal OAuth client_credentials token. Not passed by callers.

mode.demo: Simulated orders and subscriptions when PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID/PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET are unset
mode.sandbox: Real PayPal sandbox payments and billing agreements when credentials are set
